---
title: "Chao estimate other subfamilies"
format: pdf
editor: visual
---

Load packages

```{r, warning =FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(SpadeR)
library(stringr)
estimator <- "    iChao1 (Chiu et al. 2014)"

```

List subfamilies from excel file

```{r}
sub_families_list <- list.files("../Data/Bold_only/BIN_abundance_subfamilies/", 
                                full.names = TRUE)
```

Calculate iChao1 for both reared and core and compile for all species

```{r, warning =FALSE}
sub_family_outputs_all <- data.frame()

for(fm in sub_families_list){
  
  
  ## load data
  
  data_all <- read.csv(fm, skip = 1)
  
  ## filter for core and reared
  
  core <- select(data_all, BIN, count) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(count)) %>% 
    mutate(source = 'core')
  
  reared <- select(data_all, BIN= BIN.1, count = count.1) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(count)) %>% 
    mutate(source = 'reared')
  
  ## summarise total bins
  
  total <- 
    bind_rows(core, reared) %>% 
    group_by(BIN) %>% 
    summarise(count = sum(count))

  ## calculate shared, reared only and maialse only
  
  shared <- unique(c(core$BIN[core$BIN %in% reared$BIN], 
                     reared$BIN[reared$BIN %in% core$BIN]))
  
  reared_only <- reared$BIN[!reared$BIN %in% core$BIN]
  
  core_only <- core$BIN[!core$BIN %in% reared$BIN]
  
  ## Estimate iChao for core -- use try catch for subfamilies with too few bins
  
  core_estimate <- tryCatch({ 
    ChaoSpecies(core$count,"abundance",k=10,conf=0.95)},
           error = function(e) {
  template_result <- ChaoSpecies(reared$count, "abundance", k=10, conf=0.95)
  na_matrix <- template_result
  na_matrix$Species_table[] <- NA 
  na_matrix$Basic_data_information[] <- NA 
  return(na_matrix)
  })

  ## Estimate iChao for reared 
  
  reared_estimate <- ChaoSpecies(reared$count,"abundance",k=10,conf=0.95)

  subfamily <- str_remove(str_remove(str_extract(fm, "//[A-Z][a-z]*-"), "//"), "-")
  
  ## compile results in data frame
  
  sub_family_outputs_1 <- data.frame(subfamily = subfamily, 
                                     total_n_bin = nrow(total), 
                                     shared_bins = length(shared), 
                                     proportion_shared = length(shared)/nrow(total),
                                     nreared_total_bin = nrow(reared), 
                                     reared_only = length(reared_only), 
                                     core_only = length(core_only),
                                     reared_Chao1_estimate = reared_estimate$Species_table[estimator, 'Estimate'],
                                     reared_Chao1_se = reared_estimate$Species_table[estimator, 's.e.'], 
                                     reared_Chao1_95_lower = reared_estimate$Species_table[estimator, '95%Lower'], 
                                     reared_Chao1_95_upper = reared_estimate$Species_table[estimator, '95%Upper'], 
                                     reared_Chao1_CV = reared_estimate$Basic_data_information["    CV for entire dataset",2],
                                     reared_Chao1_Coverage = reared_estimate$Basic_data_information["    Coverage estimate for entire dataset",2], 
                                     core_total_bin = nrow(core), core_Chao1_estimate = core_estimate$Species_table[estimator, 'Estimate'], 
                                     core_Chao1_se = core_estimate$Species_table[estimator, 's.e.'], 
                                     core_Chao1_95_lower = core_estimate$Species_table[estimator, '95%Lower'], 
                                     core_Chao1_95_upper = core_estimate$Species_table[estimator, '95%Upper'], 
                                     core_Chao1_CV = core_estimate$Basic_data_information["    CV for entire dataset",2], 
                                     core_Chao1_Coverage = core_estimate$Basic_data_information["    Coverage estimate for entire dataset",2])
  
  sub_family_outputs_all <- bind_rows(sub_family_outputs_all, sub_family_outputs_1)
}

rownames(sub_family_outputs_all) <- NULL
 
sub_family_outputs_all
```
